name: O FUTURO É PUNK - Jubilee - Derek Jarman
description: This event is a historical and performative satire about an anarchic Great Britain, featuring an astrologer who transports Queen Elizabeth I to a dystopian future. The queen encounters a group of women navigating a society with completely broken institutions.
longDescription:
O FUTURO É PUNK - Jubilee - Derek Jarman is a cinema event scheduled for November 24, 2026, at 7:00 PM. It will take place at the Sala Principal of Teatro Municipal Constantino Nery in Matosinhos, Porto. The film has a duration of 106 minutes and includes no intermission.

The event is promoted by the Câmara Municipal de Matosinhos and offers free admission. It is classified for ages 12 and above. Attendees can park at Parque de Estacionamento da Docapesca for an additional fee of 1.05 euros.
descriptionPt: Este evento é uma sátira histórica e performática sobre uma Grã-Bretanha anárquica, com uma astróloga que transporta a Rainha Isabel I para um futuro distópico. A rainha encontra um grupo de mulheres a viver numa sociedade com instituições completamente destruídas.
